items.finding: Dont also replaces avec lequel and its gender/number variants.
items.application: Instrumental scissors use 138:285–289 requires an instrumental function, separate from de-relative ownership and topic uses.

items.finding: Trompette parlante names a horn used to carry or amplify the voice over distance, including between ships.
items.application: The full instrument phrase at 138:396–414 is not a musical trumpet or a literally talking object. Its use for listening is inferred from the tube in the ear and subsequent hearing.

items.finding: Industrie includes practical dexterity and skill in making something.
items.application: At 140:98–107, the successful improvised hearing apparatus selects ingenuity and skill rather than an industrial economic sector.

items.finding: Lier conversation means entering conversation with another person.
items.application: The infinitive construction at 145:69–86 is strike up conversation, not bind with a cord.

items.finding: Jeux de la nature can name natural productions that appear extraordinary or bizarre.
items.application: Speaking rational microscopic humans are inferred by the giants to be an extraordinary natural phenomenon at 144:55–71, not an amusement game.

items.finding: Figurative brûler can express an intense desire or extreme impatience to act.
items.application: Brûlaient d’impatience at 145:43–65 means extremely eager to converse, with no physical combustion.

items.finding: Mite is described as a nearly imperceptible small insect, with a cheese example, under a feminine noun headword.
items.application: At 144:20–25 and 145:196–201 the giants metaphorically compare the tiny humans to these minute creatures; preserve the historical insect comparison without a modern moth-only gloss or literal human taxonomy.
